notes.title: Brews and Anvils Bundle is now available!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Two crafts, one cozy bundle![/b][/p][p]We've teamed up to bring you the [b]Brews and Anvils Bundle[/b] a delightful combo of [b]Coffee Express: Barista Simulator[/b] and [b]Cozy Forge: Blacksmith Simulator[/b]![/p][p]Whether you're pouring the perfect latte or hammering out legendary swords, this bundle is made for cozy gamers who love to serve, craft, and relax. 
[/p][p]Get both games together at a discounted price:

 [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57634/Brews_and_Anvils_Bundle/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Cozy Forge is released!
notes.notes:
[p]Cozy Forge, which we designed as a game jam game, has been released with 9 different language options. We started as a small but heartfelt project, and now we are opening the doors of our tiny blacksmith shop to the whole world! 

We are grateful for your support and interest, and we hope you enjoy your time. Let us know your feedback in the community center and by joining our [url="https://discord.gg/8SfGZCCnxr"]Discord[/url] server![/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432920/Cozy_Forge_Blacksmith_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Cozy Forge Demo is available on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello, blacksmiths![/b][/p][p]The Lakefish Games team would like to thank you for your interest in our little game, Cozy Forge. As you know, the Steam Next Fest event is taking place from June 9 to 16. For independent game studios like ours, events like this are a great opportunity to showcase our work to you. That’s why we’ve decided to showcase a small portion of Cozy Forge at this event.[/p][p]You’ll be able to experience approximately 20 minutes of gameplay, with only the forge scenes active. This will allow you to get a feel for Cozy Forge’s blacksmithing philosophy, theme, and spirit. And after all that, we’ll be looking forward to your feedback.[/p][p]Shortly after the Steam Next Fest event, we will release the final version of Cozy Forge, taking your feedback into consideration.[/p][p]Get your hammers ready see you soon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601990/a58e60b1b9bd1ef46b0a29a6399af4c57cfc6369.png"][/img][/p]
